direction.premise: A field transcription instrument folds an audio signal into readable musical marks.
direction.composition: Horizontal input and waveform strip over a flowing score; controls live beside the source and selected notes.
direction.shapeLanguage: Thin staff lines, angular buttons, oval noteheads and waveform strokes create measured rhythm.
direction.surfaceAndMaterial: Matte muted mint instrument housing and near-white score; no artificial vellum texture.
direction.paletteLogic: Deep green ink for pitches and recording controls, amber for uncertain or selected notes.
direction.typography: Serif introduction gives way to practical sans-serif controls and compact monospace identifiers.
direction.signature: Actual waveform is followed by staff symbols whose noteheads highlight during synthesized playback.
direction.distinction: Signal-to-score vertical flow differs from the Press operation rail and Folkarium composition folio.

architecture.primaryVerb: Capture audio, extract pitches, adjust individual notes, then audition the resulting score.
architecture.physicalFeedback: Waveform appears after decoding, worker progress advances, and selected notes open a correction strip; playback highlights timed events.
architecture.spatialRationale: Phone uses one continuous instrument without a permanent sidebar; each measure fits the viewport and correction controls stay near the bottom.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Horizontal waveform and flowing staff replace the fixed file-operation rail and byte ledger.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Infer and edit musical notes rather than compressing or extracting files.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Mint signal strip and compact measure sequence replace the warm composition folio.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Audio capture is the input, rather than building a composition directly.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Broad waveform with notation below replaces cobalt rehearsal station panels.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Extract pitch from sound rather than practicing spoken dialogue.

comparisons.spatialDifference: A continuous audio strip and rhythmic staff replace player classification dossiers.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Correct inferred pitches rather than classifying character selections.

comparisons.spatialDifference: The measured waveform and flat staff replace an illustrated garden environment.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Record and inspect musical audio instead of growing simulated plants.

comparisons.spatialDifference: A linear time sheet replaces a tiled restoration board and brass tray.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Edit detected semitones instead of spatially dragging image tiles.

comparisons.spatialDifference: A horizontal recording strip replaces the suspended sculpture and weight table.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Adjust musical pitch and replay instead of balancing simulated torque.

comparisons.spatialDifference: A compact upright recorder replaces full-screen 3D cockpit telemetry.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Discrete transcription and replay replace steering and throttle manipulation.

comparisons.spatialDifference: A signal and flowing score replace two stacked player dossiers.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Pitch correction and MIDI export replace roster annotation and comparison.

production.renderer: Semantic HTML controls and generated SVG notation with browser audio and a worker.
production.focalAsset: Waveform-to-beamed-note vector identity, reflecting the actual signal to score transformation.

motion.character: Direct measured feedback follows the time axis of the selected recording.
motion.action: Selecting a source enables recognition and the score scrolls into view after analysis.
motion.anticipation: Record control changes label and state while capturing sound.
motion.response: Waveform updates after decoded input and progress follows analyzed frames.
motion.followThrough: Actual detected notes settle into a printable staff and playback highlights noteheads.
motion.interruption: Cancel terminates the worker; playback stop halts scheduled oscillators.
motion.reducedMotion: Without animated scrolling the signal, progress and note colors remain legible.

evidence.expectedChange: Original demonstration audio creates a six-note score with functional playback and export controls.
